prompt_md: A rooster lays an egg right on the peak of a barn roof. Which side does the egg roll down?
prompt_short: A rooster lays an egg on a roof peak. Which side does it roll down?
hint_md: Who lays eggs on a farm?
explain_intuition_md: The question makes you think about slopes and wind, but roosters are males. Only hens lay eggs, so there is no egg to roll.
explain_math_md: No math here: the trick is in the wording.
